# shadow/no-async-effect

Disallow async functions as effect or memo callbacks.

`recommended` `has suggestions`

## Why

Dependency tracking stops at the first `await`, so signals read afterward never re-run the effect, and the promise an async function returns is not a cleanup function. Start the async work from a synchronous effect (or use `useResource` for data loading).

## Incorrect

```tsx
useEffect(async () => {
  const data = await load(id());
  setData(data);
});
```

```tsx
const total = useMemo(async () => (await fetchTotal()) + extra());
```

## Correct

```tsx
useEffect(() => {
  const current = id();
  void (async () => {
    setData(await load(current));
  })();
});
```

```tsx
const data = useResource(id, (value) => load(value));
```

## Suggestions

For an effect, the suggestion keeps the parameters and wraps the body in a synchronous callback, `(params) => { void (async () => body)(); }`; signals read after an `await` are still not tracked, so read them before the async part. It is withheld for a function with type parameters or a return type annotation, and never offered for `useMemo` (use `useResource` there).

## Disabling

Disable one line with `// eslint-disable-next-line shadow/no-async-effect`, a block with `/* eslint-disable shadow/no-async-effect */` and `/* eslint-enable shadow/no-async-effect */`, or a whole file with the block form at its top. Disable it only when the callback reads no signal and returns no cleanup, so neither the lost tracking nor the ignored promise matters.

## Messages

- `asyncEffect`: Effect callbacks must not be async: tracking stops at the first `await` and the returned promise is not a cleanup function.
- `asyncMemo`: A memo must return a value synchronously, not a promise. Use `useResource` for asynchronous data.
- `wrapInner`: Run the async work inside a synchronous callback.
